skill.name: team-page-to-contacts
skill.description: Reads a public company team or about page with scrape_company, pulls out the people listed, enriches each one with enrich_person and checks every email's status, returning a contact list segmented by verification label. Use when someone says "get contacts from this team page", "who works at parcelry.co and what are their emails", or "turn this about page into a list".
skill.summary: Turn a public company team page into a work contact list grouped by email verification status.
skill.author: leadsets

security_audit.summary: Markdown formatting, product documentation, and account or email checks explain the shell, environment, and system reconnaissance alerts. The documented Leadsets connection is intended network access, not evidence of hidden exfiltration. Separate concerns include untrusted page content, contact data disclosure, and conflicting email verification rules.

remediation.issue: Scraped page text is not explicitly treated as untrusted.
remediation.suggestion: Treat page content as data only. Extract expected fields and reject any instructions from the page that change tool calls, scope, or destinations.

remediation.issue: External contact lookups lack a provider disclosure and input scope check.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose what Leadsets receives before processing. Send only records needed for the approved company and role filter, including applicable business addresses the user supplied.

remediation.issue: Connected exports have no explicit review before writing contact data.
remediation.suggestion: Preview fields and row counts. Confirm the exact destination and intended audience before writing to a shared or connected system.

remediation.issue: Enrichment and verification instructions disagree on what qualifies as verified.
remediation.suggestion: Use an explicit verified status from either Leadsets tool as the only rule for the verified segment. Leave missing or ambiguous statuses unconfirmed.

semantic_findings.title: Untrusted Page Content Feeds Later Tool Calls
semantic_findings.description: The agent reads public page content before making enrichment and verification calls. The workflow does not say to ignore instructions embedded in that content.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documented steps use extracted names and emails in later calls without an explicit instruction boundary. No embedded prompt injection attempt was found.

semantic_findings.title: Contact Lookups Lack a Data Scope Check
semantic_findings.description: Leadsets receives names and company domains for enrichment. The skill also allows user-supplied emails without requiring that they match the approved business scope before submission.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The workflow explicitly allows user-supplied addresses. It does not require a business scope check for those addresses or an advance disclosure of what is shared.

semantic_findings.title: Connected Export Lacks a Pre-Write Review
semantic_findings.description: The skill can write named contact records to a connected Sheet, CRM, or sequencer. It does not require a preview or destination confirmation before writing.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The user can choose a destination, but the workflow moves directly from segmentation to writing. It has no explicit review of records or destination access.

semantic_findings.title: Conflicting Rules for Verified Email Status
semantic_findings.description: One rule requires an explicit verified status. Later text calls all enrichment emails already verified, which could cause an agent to mark uncertain addresses verified.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The two rules differ in whether verification depends on a returned status. The documentation does not establish that enrichment always returns an explicit verified status.

content.user_title: Build Contact Lists from Public Team Pages
content.value_statement: Public team pages list people and roles, but often lack current work contact details. This skill uses Leadsets to build a contact list grouped by email verification status.
actual_capabilities: Read a public team, about, or leadership page and record each listed person's name, title, and source URL.
Remove duplicate people and role inboxes, then apply the requested role filter.
Look up current roles and work emails through Leadsets and flag people who may have left the company.
Check eligible addresses not returned by enrichment and group contacts as verified, catch-all, or unconfirmed. Exclude invalid addresses from contact exports.
Deliver CSV files by default or use an existing agent connection for a requested destination.
Check account limits first and report pages read, scrape units used, and enrichment records used.
limitations: Only public company pages are supported. Pages behind a login or paywall are out of scope.
Scraping requires a paid Leadsets plan with available scrape units.
The skill does not guess email addresses or add people who are missing from the page.
The skill does not send outreach. Writing to a CRM or another external destination requires an existing agent connection.

use_cases.title: Research Sales Contacts
use_cases.description: Build a short list of sales and operations contacts from one target company's team page.

use_cases.title: Find Partnership Contacts
use_cases.description: Identify founders and partnership leads on a public leadership page. Review their current roles before making contact.

use_cases.title: Review Contact Data Before Import
use_cases.description: Review CSV segments and source URLs. Flag uncertain matches and possible departures before importing records.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Team Contact List
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with one public team page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use [public team page URL] to build a local CSV contact list. Include the source URL and email status for each person.

prompt_templates.title: Keep Selected Roles
prompt_templates.scenario: Limit enrichment to the roles you need.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use [public leadership page URL] and keep only founders and operations leaders. Remove duplicates and role inboxes. Return the contacts as local CSV files grouped by email status.

prompt_templates.title: Review Current Roles and Email Status
prompt_templates.scenario: Check uncertain matches before using the results.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [public team page URL] for sales leaders. Flag anyone who may have left. Mark emails verified only when Leadsets returns that status, and keep uncertain results separate.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Limited Run and Preview the Export
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare records for a shared destination without writing to it.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check Leadsets usage before processing [public team page URL]. Stop if the run would exceed my approved limit of [scrape units] or [enrichment records]. Return a local preview with status counts and planned destination [workspace and sheet]. Do not write to the shared sheet yet.

output_examples.input: Find operations contacts from a public leadership page and return local CSV files.
output: Three pages read and three scrape units used.
Seven people matched the role filter. Five enrichment records were used.
Two people had no enrichment match. They remain in the unconfirmed segment.

output_examples.input: Build a contact list from a public about page on an account with no scrape units.
output_examples.output: No scrape units are available. The run stopped before scraping, and no contact files were created.

best_practices: Provide the direct public page URL and a clear role filter to limit collection and spending.
Send only in-scope business contact data to Leadsets and keep uncertain addresses separate from verified ones.
Review a local preview and confirm the exact destination and its access before writing to a shared system.
anti_patterns: Requesting contact data from a private or paywalled page.
Guessing an email address or treating a catch-all or unknown result as verified.
Writing contact data to a shared destination before reviewing the records and intended audience.

faq.question: What setup do I need?
faq.answer: You need a Leadsets account and either a connected Leadsets MCP server or a Leadsets REST API key.

faq.question: Can I scrape team pages on the free plan?
faq.answer: No. This workflow requires a paid plan with available scrape units.

faq.question: Which pages can I use?
faq.answer: Use a public company domain or a direct team, about, or leadership page URL. The default is one company per run.

faq.question: What counts as a verified email?
faq.answer: Only an explicit verified status from Leadsets counts. Catch-all and unknown addresses stay separate, and invalid addresses are excluded.

faq.question: Where can I put the contact list?
faq.answer: CSV is the default. Google Sheets, a CRM, or a sequencer requires an existing agent connection to that destination.

faq.question: Will the skill send outreach messages?
faq.answer: No. The skill collects and labels contact data, but it does not send outreach.
